goal: Production core convergence and cheap-first milestone product completion
acceptance_criteria: Mechanical milestone contracts and bounded patches
New real small dogfood then Promotion milestones through independent acceptance
No default Max or experimental optimization
No host business patches; preserve failures and UNKNOWN
Single canonical lifecycle over existing Tree/DAG/state/acceptance/delivery

quality_metrics.measure: production authority count, real accepted milestone count, model cost and illegal escalation count
quality_metrics.target: one lifecycle; independently accepted product; zero unauthorized Max calls
quality_metrics.method: static and dynamic dispatch tests, frozen acceptance, accounted provider receipts

prevention: Confirm acceptance, interfaces, and applicable kernel constraints before implementation.
improvement: Record review findings and one bounded improvement experiment.
